A rotary phase generator works by powering two of three windings in a 3 phase motor with 240 single phase.(generating a "ghost leg" which runs 2 legs of 240[180 degrees apart] and the ghost leg [at 120 degrees]) There are issues with both, but it would be nice to have some advice from someone running a setup already.
